summary: Verified the two surgical fixes to MiceForm.jsx (fallback 'Not specified' + explicit 2xx check + improved catch) via Playwright UI + network inspection. All 5 required scenarios pass. Backend returns HTTP 200 on both minimum and full submissions; success message renders; form clears; overlay scrolls to top; HTML5 email validation blocks invalid submissions; 'Not specified' fallback correctly applied when Q2/Q3 empty. No 'An error occurred' message appeared in any successful submission.
critical_code_review_comments: The 'error occurred' message the user reported was almost certainly stale cache / stale deploy. Both fixes in MiceForm.jsx are sound: (a) `destination` fallback prevents any downstream validation ambiguity, (b) explicit 2xx check is defensive but redundant since axios throws on non-2xx (harmless), (c) improved catch now logs HTTP vs network vs generic errors — good for future debugging.
Minor: 403 errors in console are unrelated background resources (likely tracker/analytics), not affecting the form.
Consider adding client-side validation for the number field q5_group_size (min=1 already set, but empty is accepted).
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_ prefixed contact form submissions were persisted via successful API calls (test@example.com, full@example.com). These are best-effort MongoDB records with 'TEST' name/company prefixes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MiceForm submission verified end-to-end. Network payload inspection confirmed correct fallback logic. If user still sees error, it is a client-side cache issue (advise hard reload with cache clear or verify production deploy commit matches this MiceForm.jsx).
rca of the issue: Original user-reported 'An error occurred' was not reproducible. Backend logs show 200 OK. Playwright confirms success UI. Root cause: stale browser cache or stale production build. Mitigation applied in MiceForm.jsx: (1) fallback value for destination avoids any 422 risk, (2) console.error now surfaces exact HTTP/network cause enabling user to share the real error next time.
